name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - West Valley City UT

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open site - no perimeter fence or gate on either the west (Commerce Center Dr) or east dock side. Dock aprons and parking are directly accessible from public roads (confirmed in 2025-07 Street View).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building - dock doors run along both the west and east long faces; trailers backed in on both sides.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long cross-dock building with continuous dock bands on west and east faces; combined doors estimated 100+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Row of trailers parked without tractors in the open paved yard off the SE corner.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Dock aprons open straight off the public road - minimal stacking depth, no controlled approach.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter derived from building footprint plus the east trailer yard.
